scripts.lint: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api ruff check scripts services/buyer-audit-api && uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api mypy services/buyer-audit-api/src && npm run lint --workspace @pbl/seller-service && npm run lint --workspace @pbl/commerce-gateway && npm run lint --workspace @pbl/dashboard
scripts.test: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api pytest services/buyer-audit-api/tests && npm test --workspace @pbl/seller-service && npm test --workspace @pbl/commerce-gateway && npm run test:schemas && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:unit: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api pytest services/buyer-audit-api/tests -m 'not mongo'
scripts.test:mongo: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api pytest services/buyer-audit-api/tests -m mongo
scripts.api: uv run --project services/buyer-audit-api uvicorn buyer_audit_api.main:app --app-dir services/buyer-audit-api/src --env-file .env.local --reload

scripts.chain:recover: forge build --root infra/contracts && node scripts/base_sepolia_setup.mjs recover
